methods.candidate_workaround: Split repository refs, clean-state, live-remote, and drive-capacity checks into separately bounded probes and preserve every result before composing the preflight receipt.
methods.failure_signature: A combined three-lane preflight exceeded its wrapper budget before returning consolidated source, owner, and drive evidence.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not combine multiple slow Windows Git status and filesystem probes under one short wrapper; bound and capture each surface independently.
methods.rollback: Give the timed-out aggregate probe zero state-verification credit and rerun only smaller read-only probes.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local read-only startup verification only; no independent-reproduction, production, security-complete, or scientific credit.

methods.candidate_workaround: Pass directories to ripgrep and express filename matching with repeated --glob filters instead of shell-style wildcard path operands on Windows.
methods.failure_signature: Ripgrep received wildcard path operands that Windows treated as invalid literal filenames.
methods.recurrence_guard: On Windows, give rg real directories and use --glob for selection; do not assume the shell expands wildcard path operands.
methods.rollback: Give the invalid inspection zero discovery credit and rerun a bounded directory-plus-glob query.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local repository inspection only; no evidence claim beyond the returned files and lines.
methods.title: Use ripgrep directory roots with explicit Windows glob filters

methods.candidate_workaround: Inspect UTF-8 source text before patching and use smaller exact hunks or an explicit apply-patch replacement when inherited display encoding may differ.
methods.failure_signature: An apply-patch hunk expected a mojibake line that did not exist in the UTF-8 file and failed verification without applying content.
methods.recurrence_guard: Read the exact UTF-8 lines before matching inherited non-ASCII text; treat display-layer corruption as untrusted patch context.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed hunk, confirm that no partial change landed, and retry only with verified UTF-8 context through apply_patch.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local additive editing only; no authority, identity, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Verify UTF-8 patch context before matching non-ASCII lines

methods.candidate_workaround: Resolve the selected skill directory first and invoke its bundled runner from the exact discovered scripts path instead of assuming repository materialization.
methods.failure_signature: A repository scripts lookup returned no Method Flow runner because the runner belongs to the selected skill package.
methods.recurrence_guard: When a skill documents a bundled runner, resolve the skill root and scripts directory before constructing a repository-relative command.
methods.rollback: Give the empty repository lookup zero runner-discovery credit and inspect only the selected skill package.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local skill-runner discovery only; no broad filesystem, production, or independent-reproduction claim.
methods.title: Resolve bundled runner paths from the selected skill root

methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the protected meaning while rewriting every exact-collision title into a phase-specific formulation, then rerun the complete prior-portfolio comparison before packet emission.
methods.failure_signature: The first x1 portfolio audit found seven normalized titles already frozen in earlier owner or sibling portfolios.
methods.recurrence_guard: Run exact normalized portfolio-title comparison before materialization and never waive a collision merely because the safety boundary is still required.
methods.rollback: Emit no x1 packet, preserve the failed collision receipt in Method Flow, rename only the colliding entries, and rerun the full audit.
methods.scope_boundary: Portfolio-title novelty only; not scientific originality, patent review, authority, or independent reproduction.
methods.title: Fail closed on inherited portfolio-title collisions before materialization

methods.candidate_workaround: Parse the two-character porcelain status prefix with anchored regular expressions, including an escaped literal question-mark pair for untracked rows.
methods.failure_signature: A PowerShell -like pattern containing question marks treated them as single-character wildcards and classified all staged rows as untracked.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use anchored regular expressions against the porcelain prefix and retain staged, unstaged, and untracked counts as separate fields.
methods.rollback: Reject the wildcard-derived count, preserve the failed observation, and rerun the same immutable status rows through anchored prefix expressions.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local Git status classification only; not repository correctness, remote equality, or independent reproduction.
methods.title: Parse porcelain status prefixes with anchored regular expressions

methods.candidate_workaround: Separate repository-wide status from constant-time branch and head probes and give the status process a measured bounded budget that includes shell startup overhead.
methods.failure_signature: A combined status branch and head shell wrapper returned exit 124 after ten seconds without usable output.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not bundle repository-wide status with independent identity probes under a ten-second wrapper; measure status separately and retain timeout evidence.
methods.rollback: Treat the combined wrapper as failed, perform no mutation, and rerun branch, head, and status as separate read-only probes.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local Git inspection latency only; not remote equality, repository correctness, production performance, or independent reproduction.
methods.title: Separate repository-wide status from constant-time identity probes
